notes: Andrew, 2026-10-23: "For master bed, I prefer simpler beds like https://www.ikea.com/us/en/p/malm-bed-frame-dark-brown-veneer-luroey-s09574348/ (no drawers), but have drawers available in case wife says so." His link is the King (ikea-09574348, too wide for the room); this is the same bed in Queen, staged in master-bedroom a, and in b with the MALM underbed storage boxes (ikea-50599440). The page: "If you need space for extra bedding, add MALM bed storage boxes on casters" (8 1/4" under the frame), so drawers can be added later without changing the bed. Stock 2026-10-23, as on 2026-10-22: Last chance; 2 of 3 in stock at IKEA Long Island, NY; currently unavailable for Click and collect and for delivery to our ZIP, so it is bought in the store. Rejected on 2026-10-22 for that stock alone; Andrew's preference brings it back as a candidate. Flat-pack, so F-22 does not flag it. Queen frame + Luröy set 495.743.65. Popularity: Best seller (#3 on the Bed frames list sorted Most popular, 2026-10-22); 3.9 stars (1236).
